[[File:Restraining_Bolt_cutaway.jpg|thumb|right|Cutaway of a restraining bolt with Ion Pulse Generator indicated]]
An '''Ion Pulse Generator''' was a component of a [[Restraining bolt/Legends|restraining bolt]]. It delivered an ion jolt to the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] it was attached to when commands were issued by the [[Droid caller/Legends|caller]].
